facts.value: Operates and maintains the national electricity grid: generation, transmission, distribution. Handles grid-side outages, power line faults, transformer failures, meter issues, and public lighting on EDL-owned infrastructure. Complaint domains encoded for routing: electricity_outage, power_line_fault, transformer_fault, meter_bill, sparking_wire_grid_side, public_lighting_grid.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: private_generator_faults; internal_building_wiring; zahle_district(use_EDZ); mobile_network_infrastructure; zahle_concession_area_faults; Route instead to EDZ when If complaint location is Zahle district or EDZ concession area do not route to EDL.; private_generator_faults_or_subscription_disputes; Route instead to HITL_PRIVATE_GENERATOR_OR_LOCAL_REGULATOR when Private generator equipment and subscription disputes are not EDL grid faults.; internal_building_wiring_or_private_breaker_faults; Route instead to HITL_PRIVATE_PROPERTY when Faults after the private meter or inside the building are not ordinary EDL dispatch.; streetlight_fixture_out_without_grid_hazard; Route instead to MUN when Local public lighting fixture complaints default to municipality unless supply/grid hazard is visible.; areas_outside_zahle_concession; Route instead to EDL when Use EDZ only for confirmed Zahle concession area.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.
